title: Image Upload with Resize
description: Upload images, serve them, resize on upload via query param, and generate thumbnails.

steps.title: Image upload endpoint
steps.description: Implement POST /upload that accepts an image file, stores it in memory, and returns 200 with file info (name, size, type).
hints: Store the buffer in an in-memory map

steps.title: Serve images
steps.description: Implement GET /images/:name that returns a previously uploaded image with the correct Content-Type header.
hints: Look up the image by name

steps.title: Upload with resize
steps.description: Accept a ?width=100 query param on POST /upload. If provided, resize the image to that width (maintaining aspect ratio) before storing.
hints: Use sharp library for image resizing
Parse width from query params (default: no resize)

steps.title: Thumbnail endpoint
steps.description: Implement GET /images/:name/thumbnail that returns a smaller version (200px wide) of the uploaded image. Generate the thumbnail on-the-fly if it does not exist yet.
hints: Resize the stored image to 200px width
Cache the thumbnail for subsequent requests
Return the thumbnail with appropriate Content-Type
